content.text:
inventory what all superfunctions needs an admin UI (compare with equivalent commercial Platform as a service...) like better-auth, clerk, descope, auth0 for authfn, resend for sendfn etc...

do it as fast as possible

Checked against current official product docs on 2026-08-13.

| Superfunction | Closest commercial equivalents | What the commercial control plane manages | Admin UI need |
|---|---|---|---|
| `authfn` | [Auth0](https://auth0.com/docs/get-started/auth0-overview/dashboard), [Clerk](https://clerk.com/docs/guides/dashboard/analytics) | Applications/APIs, identity connections, users, organizations, roles, MFA, branding, domains, email templates, actions, logs, tenant settings and usage. | **Core** |
| `cachefn` | [Upstash Redis](https://upstash.com/docs/redis/overall/getstarted), [Redis Cloud](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rc/) | Cache/database creation, regions and replicas, credentials, eviction/limits, backups, metrics, plans and usage. | **Core** |
| `drawfn` | [Miro Developer Platform](https://developers.miro.com/docs/create-a-developer-team) | Boards/projects, teams, sharing/access and—on the developer side—apps, OAuth credentials, scopes, install URLs and environments. | **Conditional**: essential for hosted collaboration; SDK-only DrawFn can work without one. |
| `plugfn` | [Nango](https://docs.nango.dev/integrations/all/microsoft-teams), [Pipedream Connect](https://pipedream.com/docs/connect/) | Provider integrations, OAuth app credentials/scopes, customer connections, environments/secrets, syncs/webhooks, proxy requests, request logs and errors. | **Core** |
| `searchfn` | [Algolia](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/sending-and-managing-data/send-and-update-your-data), [Typesense Cloud](https://typesense.org/docs/guide/typesense-cloud.html) | Applications/indices, records/imports, schema and relevance settings, synonyms/rules, API keys, query analytics, usage and billing. | **Core** |
| `secfn` | [Infisical](https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/project), [Doppler](https://docs.doppler.com/docs/dashboard) | Projects/environments, secrets and versions, identities, roles/policies, integrations, rotations, scanning, certificates and searchable audit logs. | **Core** |
| `testfn` | [BrowserStack](https://www.browserstack.com/docs/test-management/overview/reports-and-dashboards), [Sauce Labs](https://docs.saucelabs.com/test-results/) | Projects, test cases/plans/runs, browsers/devices, sessions and artifacts, results, unique failures, flakiness, health and reports. | **Core for hosted testing** |
| `botfn` | [Botpress](https://botpress.com/docs/studio/get-started/manage-your-agent/monitor/), [Voiceflow](https://docs.voiceflow.com/) | Bots/agents, visual workflows, prompts/tools, knowledge, channels/integrations, users/conversations, logs/events/issues, analytics and spend. | **Core** |
| `hostfn` | [Vercel](https://vercel.com/docs/projects), [Render](https://render.com/docs) | Projects/services, deployments and rollbacks, Git linkage, domains, environment variables, logs/observability, firewall/protection and usage. | **Core** |
| `uifn` | [Bit Cloud](https://bit.dev/docs/getting-started/collaborate/remote-scope/), [Chromatic](https://www.chromatic.com/docs/) | Component scopes/catalog, packages and versions, builds, previews, documentation, dependency graphs, permissions, UI tests and review baselines. | **Optional/narrow** unless UIFn becomes a hosted component registry/design-system service. |
| `watchfn` | [Better Stack Uptime](https://betterstack.com/docs/uptime/monitoring-start/), [Checkly](https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/) | Monitors/heartbeats, check frequency and locations, incidents, on-call/escalations, maintenance, status pages, history and reports. | **Conditional**: core for cloud monitoring; not justified for a local file-watcher alone. |
| `billfn` | [Stripe Billing](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/build-subscriptions), [Paddle](https://developer.paddle.com/) | Product/price catalog, customers, subscriptions, usage meters, invoices, discounts, trials, payment failures/dunning, tax, revenue and webhooks. | **Core** |
| `browsefn` | [Browserbase](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/browser/observability/session-recording), [Browserless](https://docs.browserless.io/) | Projects/API keys, browser sessions, live view, video replay, page/network/debug artifacts, concurrency, regions, limits and usage. | **Core** |
| `chartfn` | [Grafana Cloud](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/connect-externally-hosted/data-sources/concepts/), [Metabase Cloud](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/cloud/) | Data sources and credentials, dashboards/panels, queries, folders, sharing/permissions, alerts, integrations and usage. | **Core control plane**, though much of it is also the end-user product UI. |
| `datafn` | [Airbyte Cloud](https://docs.airbyte.com/), [Fivetran](https://fivetran.com/docs/getting-started) | Sources, destinations, connectors, credentials, connections, selected streams/schema, schedules, sync history/errors and usage. | **Core** |
| `docsfn` | [Mintlify](https://www.mintlify.com/docs/dashboard/roles), [ReadMe](https://docs.readme.com/main/docs) | Git source, editor/content/navigation, deployments, versions, custom domains, members/roles, API keys, integrations, analytics, feedback and search gaps. | **Core** |
| `filefn` | [Cloudinary](https://cloudinary.com/documentation/media_library_for_developers), [Filestack](https://www.filestack.com/docs/) | Assets/folders, uploads and presets, tags/metadata, access control, transformations, moderation, delivery settings, keys and usage. | **Core** |
| `flowfn` | [Inngest](https://www.inngest.com/docs/guides/logging), [Temporal Cloud](https://docs.temporal.io/cloud) | Functions/workflows and events, run traces and step state, queues/concurrency, retries, cancellation/replay, schedules, logs/errors, environments and keys. | **Core** |
| `iconfn` | [Font Awesome Kits](https://docs.fontawesome.com/web/setup/use-kit) | Icon/style selection, custom uploads, rendering technology, library version, hosted/package delivery, allowed domains and pageview usage. | **Optional/narrow** unless IconFn offers hosted kits/custom-icon delivery. |
| `logfn` | [Better Stack Logs](https://betterstack.com/docs/logs/logging-start/), [Axiom](https://axiom.co/docs) | Sources/tokens, ingestion, live tail/search, saved queries, dashboards/charts, alerts, retention, team access and usage. | **Core** |
| `mailfn` | [Mailosaur](https://mailosaur.com/docs/managing-your-account), [MailSlurp](https://docs.mailslurp.com/) | Programmable inboxes/domains, received messages/SMS and attachments, users/permissions, scoped API keys, account limits and usage. | **Core** |
| `sendfn` | [Resend](https://resend.com/docs/dashboard/api-keys/introduction), [Postmark](https://postmarkapp.com/developer) | Sending domains/DNS, scoped API keys, sent-email logs and status, contacts/segments/broadcasts, webhooks, exports, usage and team access. | **Core** |

Bottom line: **18 unambiguous admin/control-plane UIs**: `authfn`, `cachefn`, `plugfn`, `searchfn`, `secfn`, `testfn`, `botfn`, `hostfn`, `billfn`, `browsefn`, `chartfn`, `datafn`, `docsfn`, `filefn`, `flowfn`, `logfn`, `mailfn`, and `sendfn`.

`watchfn` becomes core only if positioned as hosted monitoring. `drawfn`, `uifn`, and `iconfn` need narrower management surfaces only when they gain cloud collaboration, registry, or hosted-delivery features.
